answer: In PoA, each identity escrows bonded collateral, and attestations carry cryptographic evidence linking related actions. When k identities coordinate an equivocation, the aggregate penalty scales quadratically, O(k^2), rather than linearly. Once detected, the sybil swarm also faces an exponential multiplier in capital loss through recursive slashing and asymmetric depreciation. A dune beacon and jade audit markers can expose correlation without relying on identity labels.
